title: BizFlood Underwriting Guideline — Number of Policies per Business and One Live Policy per Location
content:
A business may hold any number of BizFlood Commercial Flood Policies (Surplus Lines), but a location may be scheduled on only one live BizFlood policy at a time; locations of one insured are normally combined on a single BizFlood Multi-Location or BizFlood Large Property policy. Each policy is rated, billed and settled on its own.

## The guideline in parts

| Subject | Rule |
|---|---|
| Policies per business | No maximum: a business may hold any number of BizFlood policies. |
| Policies per location | A location may be scheduled on only one live BizFlood policy at a time. |
| Several locations of one insured | Normally combined on a single BizFlood Multi-Location or BizFlood Large Property policy. |
| Rating, billing and settlement | Each policy on its own. |

## Basis Q&A

**Is there a cap on how many BizFlood policies one business can hold?**
No. The guideline sets no maximum number of policies per business.

**Can the same location appear on two live BizFlood policies?**
No. A location may be scheduled on only one live BizFlood policy at a time, however many policies the business holds.

**When a business holds two BizFlood policies, are they rated or billed together?**
No. Each policy is rated, billed and settled on its own; the premium, the billing and any claim settlement of one policy are figured without reference to the other.

## Illustration (hypothetical holdings)

A hypothetical business holds one BizFlood policy scheduling its warehouse and a second BizFlood policy scheduling its showroom. The two holdings are consistent with the guideline, because no location is on both live policies. Each of the two policies has its own premium, its own bill and its own claim settlement.
